So, being trustworthy is important. I also think about the Golden Rule, which is to treat others as I want to be treated. If someone took my wallet, I would feel violated and upset. So, taking someone else's wallet is not treating them as I would want to be treated. There's also the aspect of repentance. If I did take the wallet, I should feel sorry and make things right.
